description: A previously provisioned DB cluster (RDS) was deleted. When a DB cluster is being deleted, all automated backups for that DB cluster are deleted and can't be recovered.
detector_tags: Cloud Data Asset Disaster Recovery Risks, Data Detection & Response
investigative_actions: Check which cluster was deleted. Check if there are any manual backups for that cluster (as they are not affected by this action).
name: AWS RDS cluster deletion
